showcase.title: Image Filling
showcase.subtitle: Design a reusable frame layout, place images into each region, and export polished composites with full style and codec control.
showcase.previewAlt: Image Filling layout and final composition preview

tips.tip1: Start with Auto Generators when you need a clean layout fast, then switch to Manual Editor for precise tweaks.
tips.tip2: In Fill Workspace, drag, zoom, and rotate each image inside its frame to align subjects exactly where you want.
tips.tip3: Use canvas and border overrides to keep a consistent visual style across multiple outputs from one template.
tips.tip4: Reuse saved templates to speed up social cards, collage sets, and catalog-like production workflows.

faqs.q1: How is Image Filling different from Image Splicing?
faqs.a1: Image Splicing stitches independent images into a generated strip or grid automatically. Image Filling uses a fixed template you design first, then lets you place and transform images inside each predefined region.
faqs.q2: What workflows is this tool best for?
faqs.a2: It is ideal for template-based production where consistency matters: social cards, collage layouts, and product showcase compositions with repeated structure.
faqs.q3: How can I create a layout quickly?
faqs.a3: You have three approaches: Manual Editor for custom drawing, Symmetric Generator for mirrored structures, and Grid Designer for fast bento-like layouts.
faqs.q4: Can I edit auto-generated layouts manually afterward?
faqs.a4: Yes. Templates created from Symmetric Generator or Grid Designer can be sent to Manual Editor for final fine-tuning before filling.
faqs.q5: Can I export a PSD file from the Template List to use in Photoshop or Affinity?
faqs.a5: Yes. You can. Just hover over the template and click the Export PSD button. The PSD export is structure-first: it preserves your layer shapes and positions, but it does not include per-layer photo fills from the Fill workspace session.
faqs.q6: Can I share a URL so others can open my design?
faqs.a6: No. The workflow is local-first and stores data in your browser environment, so there is no server-hosted share link for template sessions.
faqs.q7: Do style settings get saved with my template?
faqs.a7: Yes. Layout structure and style-related settings can be reused through templates, which makes repeat runs much faster.
faqs.q8: I cannot fill the image into layer after I create the template?
faqs.a8: This seems to be related to the web-state management. We are working on it. For now, please reload the page and the problem will be solved.

tooltips.overrideLayerBorders: Override the border settings for all layers in the canvas.
tooltips.gradientMode:
For gradient border color:
- Per Layer = separate gradient per shape.
- Unified = one shared gradient across whole canvas.
tooltips.overrideCornerRadius: Override the corner radius settings for all layers in the canvas.
tooltips.borderDisabled: Disabled because Canvas border override is enabled.
tooltips.radiusDisabled: Disabled because Canvas corner radius override is enabled.
tooltips.ungroupSelectedLayer: Ungroup the selected layer from its current group.
tooltips.groupSelectedLayer: Group the selected layer. If it is already grouped, this button will ungroup it.
tooltips.selectionHelpDesc: Drag layers from the canvas or Layers list to reorder. Hold Ctrl (or Cmd on Mac) and click layers to toggle multi-select. When nothing is selected, drag on empty canvas to box-select layers fully inside the selection area.
tooltips.numberOfAxes: How many parallel axes to generate
tooltips.baseLength: Length of the base edge on the primary side of each generated shape.
tooltips.sideLength: Distance between the two parallel axes used by each generated shape.
tooltips.oppositeLength: Length of the edge opposite to Base Length. Set 0 to collapse into a triangle.
tooltips.oppositeOffset: Offset of the opposite base relative to the main base along the appearance axis.
tooltips.shapeSpacing: Gap between shapes on same axis
tooltips.firstShapePosition: Offset of the first shape on each axis
tooltips.firstAxisPosition: Position of the first axis on the perpendicular coordinate
tooltips.oddEvenAxisOffset: Offset applied to even-numbered axes for diagonal patterns
tooltips.oddEvenShapeReverse: Creates interleaving symmetric patterns by reversing shape orientation on odd/even sequence.
tooltips.symmetricHelpDesc:
• You can adjust size and spacing visually using the first two components on the first main axis, and the first component on the second main axis.
• Use arrow keys to nudge the selected control (hold Shift for larger steps).
tooltips.rowCount: Set how many horizontal rows the layout should generate.
tooltips.outerPadding: Spacing between the canvas edge and the generated grid.
tooltips.rowDefinition:
Definition Guide:
• Enter 1 number (e.g. "3"): Splits into equal cells.
• Enter ratios (e.g. "2 1", "1 2 1"): Customizes cell proportions.
• Merge indicators (e.g. "1a 2", "1a 1 1"): Merges matching cells across adjacent rows/columns.
• Enter "-": Inherits the exact definition from the previous row/column.
tooltips.uniformColumns: Use one shared row definition for every row.
